recommendation: Keep the audit commit for FHIR core. If current Citation/CitedArtifactStatusType behavior needs further validation or correction, handle it in the external repository or IG that now owns Citation rather than in the core FHIR checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-34446 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by the CDS WG. It requested adding PublicationStatus retired and unknown to the CitedArtifactStatusType value set so Citation.citedArtifact.currentState could represent status values from cited FHIR resources without relying on an extensible out-of-value-set code.
initial_application: Commit 9130cf3988b8a135ec0def184962ad2b7a1c02a5, merged by HL7/fhir#2261 on 2022-08-29, changed source/citation/valueset-cited-artifact-status-type.xml to include the cited-artifact-status-type code system plus PublicationStatus retired and unknown. That matched the operative Jira resolution for the R5 core source.
additional_context: Later core history moved the relevant artifacts out of current core scope. FHIR-39632/caa1fb75adbcca96f92873c7d958e31f547124bb deleted the cited-artifact status code system and value set source from core, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 later removed the remaining active Citation resource source and build entries. Current core narrative links Citation to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG and says Citation moved there.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The current core source has no active Citation resource entry, no tracked source/citation files, and no active CitedArtifactStatusType value set source to edit. Reintroducing deleted Citation terminology in core would be outside current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Applied/Persuasive terminology move that deleted source/citation/codesystem-cited-artifact-status-type.xml and source/citation/valueset-cited-artifact-status-type.xml from core; already represented on the combined branch.

Another Citation issue already audited on the combined branch as external-repo; it shares the current-build conclusion that Citation moved out of core but concerns relatesTo, not currentState status terminology.
